channelsSubtitle: Bring Facebook and Instagram conversations into one workspace.
emptyConnectionsBody: Connect a Facebook Page or Instagram professional account to start receiving conversations.
setupBody: Ask your administrator to configure Meta credentials, an HTTPS callback origin and a secure encryption key.
facebookBody: Connect a Facebook Page to reply to customers in Messenger.
instagramBody: Connect an Instagram Business or Creator account using Instagram Login.
otherBody: This channel is not available yet.
botHint: Bind an active, trained bot to enable automatic replies.
noBots: Create a bot before enabling automatic replies.
loadError: Unable to load data. Please try again.
connectionError: Authorization failed. Check account access, granted messaging permissions and your application configuration.
popupBlocked: Allow popups in your browser to connect an account.
authorizationTimeout: Authorization timed out. Start a new connection.
emptyInboxBody: Connect a channel, then ask a customer to send a message. Verified incoming messages appear automatically.
selectConversationBody: Keep customer conversations organized, share notes and take over whenever needed.
sendHint: Sending a reply pauses automatic replies. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
windowClosed: The 24-hour reply window has closed. Wait for a new customer message.
unknown: Delivery unknown — check Meta before sending again
messageError: Message could not be sent. Check the conversation window and channel authorization.
pendingHint: A pending or unknown message is never resent automatically. Check the platform before sending again.
textOnly: Text messaging is available. Media messages are not supported yet.
selectAccounts: Select the accounts to connect. Access tokens remain on the server.
consentHint: Messaging access requires the correct Meta application permissions and, for public customers, App Review.

attachment.noBot: Bind a bot to this channel to use its image library.

integrations.title: Platform integrations
integrations.workspaceSubtitle: Connect pages and choose which bot answers each one.
integrations.botSubtitle: Connect pages to the bot so it advises and answers customers automatically.
integrations.feedbackPrefix: Which platform should we integrate next?
integrations.feedbackEmphasis: Share your ideas and feedback with us.
integrations.searchPlaceholder: Search by page name or ID...
integrations.comingSoonBody: We are finishing this integration. For now you can connect Facebook and Instagram.
integrations.emptyBody: Connect a Facebook Page or an Instagram account to start receiving messages.
integrations.botEmptyBody: This is the first step: connect a Facebook Page or an Instagram account and the bot will answer customers who message it.
integrations.assignBody: Applies to {{count}} selected pages. Only active pages can be assigned a bot.
integrations.botPagesBody: Choose the pages this bot answers automatically.
integrations.noConnectedPages: No active pages yet. Connect a page first.
integrations.moveBody: {{count}} pages are answered by another bot. That bot will stop answering them.
integrations.deactivateBody: The pages will be disconnected and stop receiving messages. You can reconnect them at any time.
integrations.botDeactivateBody: The bot will stop answering these pages. They stay connected to the workspace.
integrations.partialError: Some pages were not updated. Please try again.
integrations.bindFailed: The pages were connected but could not be assigned to the bot. Use Edit to assign them.

inbox.title: Chat
inbox.emptyTitle: Choose a conversation to get started
inbox.emptyBody: The AI bot answers customers on every channel. You can review and take over at any time.

fanpage.title: Facebook posts and comments
fanpage.description: Reply with the originating post context. Public replies, private replies and moderation are independent and off by default.
fanpage.error: Unable to save or load. Please retry.
fanpage.permissions: Reconnect your Page after granting post-reading and engagement permissions in Meta. Bind an active bot to enable automatic replies.
fanpage.privateReplies: Automatically send a private reply to commenters
fanpage.hideComments: Automatically hide comments matching configured keywords
fanpage.keywords: Hide keywords (one per line, at least 2 characters)
fanpage.moderationHelp: Only explicit keyword matches are hidden. Other complaints remain visible for staff review. Hidden comments are not deleted; you can unhide them below.
fanpage.postError: Unable to read posts. Check Meta permissions and reconnect the Page.
fanpage.review: Needs staff review · automatic replies paused
fanpage.unknown: Unknown delivery · do not resend blindly
fanpage.groundedReason: Reply grounded in the source post
